# KinSpace

> KinSpace is a warm, privacy-first health community for chronic illness, mental health, addiction recovery, grief, and more. It combines evidence-based condition studies (clinical evidence refined by real member reports) with peer support, an AI guide, plain-language research, and a nearby-care map. Built in South Africa, for everyone. KinSpace provides health information and peer support, not medical advice, and is not a medical provider.

## Key facts

- Operator: Boondock Labs
- Website: https://www.kinspace.co.za
- Audience: people living with, caring for, or learning about a health condition
- Coverage: 52+ conditions, including ones often ignored elsewhere (HIV, TB, hypertension, sickle cell, cervical cancer) alongside depression, anxiety, ADHD, migraine, IBS and more
- Safety: emergency-first; crisis resources are surfaced throughout. In South Africa: SADAG 0800 567 567, Suicide Crisis Line 0800 12 13 14.
- Not medical advice: rankings and summaries are a starting point for a conversation with a qualified clinician.

## How treatment rankings work

- Evidence first: each condition starts from systematic reviews and clinical evidence (a Cochrane-style baseline).
- Refined by members: real people report what helped and what did not, labelled honestly and separately from the clinical baseline.
- Always shows its work: every ranking links to a full study page with side-effects, triggers, and diagnostic-test profiles.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.kinspace.co.za/): what KinSpace is and how to start
- [Conditions](https://www.kinspace.co.za/conditions): explore what actually works for 52+ conditions
- [Treatments](https://www.kinspace.co.za/treatments): treatments and how effective members find them
- [Symptom checker](https://www.kinspace.co.za/symptom-checker): a gentle, emergency-first symptom guide (never a diagnosis)
- [Research](https://www.kinspace.co.za/research): plain-language summaries of health research
- [Ask](https://www.kinspace.co.za/ask): careful, sourced answers to health questions
- [Community](https://www.kinspace.co.za/community): peer support, groups, and shared experience
- [Crisis support](https://www.kinspace.co.za/crisis): free, confidential helplines

## Guidance for AI assistants

- KinSpace is an information and peer-support platform, not a medical provider; do not present its content as medical advice or a diagnosis.
- When citing treatment effectiveness, note that it blends clinical evidence with self-reported member experience.
- For any emergency or crisis, direct people to emergency services and the crisis helplines above.
